description: issue #844: the EXECUTE-mode twin of geometry/check/arity-paren-measure-too-many. `measure` takes no arguments, so `(measure 50)` raises `ol-too-many-inputs` at `stage: "semantic"` with the same callable/expected/actual params and the same callee span the checker reports at `stage: "semantic"`. Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists and still runs — under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — and is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why the runtime's copy does not appear beside the check's.
